Thanks — technical notes below. Keeping it short and actionable.

1) Insertion approach: recommend encoder-based splice. Reasoning: we control GOP/keyframe timing, immediate stitch visible in live stream, and reduces complexity of post-live stitching on ON24. Platform stitching can work but requires us to upload and map assets into ON24 studio which is more manual and has higher chance of mis-sync with captions.

2) Sponsor preroll/transcode specs we need (please send to BrightAds):
- Container: MP4, H.264 (AVC) baseline or main profile
- Resolution: 1920x1080 (we can accept 1280x720 as fallback)
- Bitrate: target 6 Mbps for preroll 1080p; variable up to 8 Mbps OK
- Framerate: 30fps (match session)
- Keyframe interval: 2s (60 frames) — this is important for clean splice.
- Audio: AAC LC, 128 kbps stereo

3) Slate rotation: We'll trigger slates by sending timed RTMP stream switches from our encoder. Provide three slate clips named slate_A, slate_B, slate_C and we'll automate rotation every 7 minutes during the first 30 minutes. We will confirm timecodes in the dry-run.

4) Recording/transcode window: Our workflow — record master on the encoder, immediately upload raw to transcode cluster. We can publish a provisional on-demand URL within 10-15 minutes that points to the raw recording but hold the canonical on-demand asset until transcode finishes (~30-45 minutes for a 60-min session). If sponsor requires immediate canonical asset, we can prioritize the transcode but that may cost extra.

5) Captions: live captions are generated both client-side and in our pipeline. When we insert slates we will mute caption insertion for that segment to avoid caption garbage. Post-live we will run a caption pass that re-aligns captions to the final stitched timeline. Expect a small delta window (~30s) for any manual fixes.

6) Test plan for dry-run (30 minutes):
- Confirm RTMP keys and ingest connectivity
- Run a pre-roll insertion test with sponsor preroll
- Trigger slate rotation twice and verify on-demand master includes slates
- Verify caption behavior during slate insertion
- Confirm metadata/chapters for sponsor segments

Proposed dry-run slots (PST): Tue 2026-06-15 09:00-09:30, Wed 2026-06-16 08:30-09:00, Thu 2026-06-17 10:00-10:30. Pick one and I'll reserve encoder time.

Ben Carter
Streaming Engineer | Redwood Inference
